question: What out-of-plane compressive strain was imposed on the V2O5, what in-plane tensile strain does the Poisson estimate give for it and with what coefficient, and what is the ratio of the two?
expect: 0.5% out of plane, 1.6% in plane with v = 0.3 (p3.L24-28): ratio 3.2
rendered: According to the document, an out-of-plane compressive strain of less than 1% was imposed on the V2O5. The Poisson ratio used is 0.3. This results in an in-plane tensile strain of 1.6% (0.5% compressive strain * 0.3 Poisson ratio). The ratio of the in-plane tensile strain to the out-of-plane compressive strain is 1.6/0.5 = 3.2.
